messages:
alex: CI is red on hosted-integration after the latest main merge (abc123). Failing tests are auth-* and streaming-* (toolcall path). Seen by anyone else? :thinking:

ci-bot: workflow hosted-integration (run #472) failed on job `integration-tests`
- failing tests: AuthServiceTest::token_refresh, StreamingToolCallTest::streaming_chunk_boundary
- logs: https://ci.internal/runs/472

jamie: Ugh. I saw a couple of 401s in the logs earlier. Trying to reproduce locally w/ the docker dev stack.

priya: Logs show: 401 from /v1/auth/token with body: `{\"error\":\"invalid_client\"}` around timestamp 2026-03-17T15:03Z. Could be a client-id rotation in staging secrets?

alex: No secret rotation on prod/staging per ops, but we did push an auth middleware change in abc123. Might be a regression.

riley: Quick check: can someone curl the token endpoint with current CI token?

jamie: Running:```bash
curl -s -D - -X POST https://hosted-api.internal/v1/auth/token \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN\" \n  -d '{\"grant_type\":\"client_credentials\"}'
```
Response:```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{\"error\":\"invalid_client\"}
```

dani: That matches CI. Token looks valid in vault? @pri ya can you confirm secrets? :eyes: (sorry ping)

priya: Checked vault: CI_CLIENT_ID points to old client-id-42. The middleware change now expects header `X-Client-Id` in addition to token for tool-calls. Tests didn't set that header, so 401. Not sure why CI started failing now though — should've been failing earlier.

alex: Hmm so middleware was merged but tests relied on the older behavior. Why did it break only after abc123? Maybe middleware was behind a feature flag that flipped in runtime config? I'll check rollout.

jamie: Short-term unblock: we can add compatibility layer in auth middleware to accept token-only for requests from internal CI subnet. But that's risky. Alternative: update tests to set header.

riley: For triage, can we bisect to identify the commit that introduced the header requirement? If it's abc123 that's our suspect.

dani: I can run a git bisect on the auth service repo. Need a minimal reproducer. Which service to bisect: auth-mw or hosted-api gateway?

alex: Start with auth-mw. Good: known-good at 1799940000 (before abc120) and bad at current main. Use:```bash
git bisect start
git bisect bad abc123
git bisect good 1799940000
# run unit + integration-local which exercise header parsing
```

dani: On it. If someone can queue a CI rerun for only the failing suite, that'd speed confirmation. @ci-bot can you rerun job `integration-tests` for run #472 with env OVERRIDE_RUN=auth,streaming ?

ci-bot: Rerun requested by dani accepted. Queued job 472.1 for `integration-tests` (target: auth,streaming). ETA ~4m.

priya: One more datapoint: streaming toolcall code path was updated in abc095 to include header validation too, but behind flag `toolcall_strict_headers=false`. That flag was toggled true in runtime config push last night (ops change #789). So two changes aligned: middleware change + flag flip = sudden CI break.

alex: Great catch. So root cause is config flip + code expecting header. Remediation options: revert runtime flag, or update tests and CI to include X-Client-Id header. Ops, which is easier?

riley: Ops prefers runtime flag revert for immediate green, then follow-up to update tests. I'll ping ops channel.

jamie: Meanwhile dani, how's bisect?

dani: Bisect narrowed it: commit 0f4b2a9 introduced header enforcement in auth-mw. Marking that as culprit. Pushed a temporary branch auth-mw/compat-ci that accepts token-only for internal callers.

alex: Ok let's land compat patch to unblock, then schedule a proper fix with tests and updating runtime config docs. Can someone open a follow-up ticket linking ops change #789 and commit 0f4b2a9?

priya: I'll open the ticket: INFRA-2317 — title: \"Hosted integ: toolcall/auth header enforcement caused CI failures\". Assign to auth-mw & tests.

riley: Ops notified, flag revert in progress. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Job 472.1 passed. All integration tests green.

alex: Excellent. Thanks everyone for the quick triage. Follow-up: PR for compat patch linked in INFRA-2317 and I'll owner the long-term fix. Closing thread after ticket created. :white_check_mark:
